«هر ملتی از تاریخ باید پند بگیرد. پندی که ما گرفتیم چه بود؟ این بود که هر ملتی که میخواهد با سربلندی زندگی کند باید آماده جانفشانی و دادن قربانی و تلفات باشد…

items.tx:
Trump has made a last minute decision not to resume the war with Iran immediately.

The military head of Israel has refused to start a war solely for the purpose of postponing the elections sought by Netanyahu.

For the first time, the US is endorsing a candidate for Israeli Prime Minister. That is none other than Netanyahu.

But Netanyahu has become quite unpopular in Israel. His chances of forming a government after tomorrow’s elections are uncertain and difficult.

Trump has said that he may start the war with the Iran after the November 3rd midterm elections. Democrats are expected to win and control the House.

Democrats may want to impeach Trump if they gain control. Already, there is discussion of investigations into Trump’s administration and Elon Musk. 

Musk himself anticipates a very difficult time for him under a Democratic House.

As a private citizen without government immunity for private actions, Elon Musk is expected to face greater scrutiny after the midterms.

Elon Musk is now the largest political donor ever in America. For the midterm elections alone, he is funding Republican groups more than $445 million.

More twists and turns in the times to come.

items.tx:
Just monitored 10 seconds of Fars News Agency (the official IRGC mouthpiece). Here is what the regime in Tehran is desperately promoting right now:

1️⃣ Quoting Gadi Eisenkot verbatim: Splashing Eisenkot’s attacks on Netanyahu ("Bibi is mad, destroyed the military, destroying the economy") across their top headlines. Why is IRGC’s terror apparatus amplifying Eisenkot? Because Tehran desperately needs an Israeli leadership like him.

2️⃣ Promoting Barack Obama: Celebrating Obama’s remarks claiming the occupying regime in Iran has “veto power over the Strait of Hormuz” and that the US/allies are depleted. Tehran loves Western appeasers who market the regime’s supposed strength.

3️⃣ Rallying for a Nuclear Bomb: Parading IRGC zealots demanding an immediate nuclear breakout.

The picture is clearer than daylight: Tehran is banking on two things to survive: Bibi losing power, and Western appeasers paving their way.

items.tx:
A few days ago I said that the facts pointed to an understanding between the Houthis and the Saudis, involving Iran and even Trump, to keep the war on land and preserve infrastructure on both sides. 

That arrangement held for a while, but it has now collapsed after the US pressured the governments of Iraq and Pakistan to close or severely restrict their borders with Iran.
The response is the return of the front in Yemen without any restrictions or relief.

This will escalate in mid time and shows that the subjugation of Iran never left Netanyahu’s agenda or Trump’s.

Writing about conflicts, and this one in particular. requires reading and rereading while interpreting new facts that shift the dynamics.

It demands a long article.

BREAKING: Netanyahu says Iran has now restarted its nuclear program and intends to destroy Israel within a short time. 

"Iran has restarted its nuclear program, and it wants to destroy us within a short time," Netanyahu said an hour ago.

IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir has warned that resuming the war this close to Tuesday's election will force the vote to be postponed indefinitely.

Netanyahu said on Wednesday that toppling the Iranian regime is now his directive to the IDF and Mossad.
